exe:FUNCTION__CDO_SELYEAR.sdo:description: This module selects a year range in the input field.

exe:FUNCTION__CDO_YEARSUM.sdo:description: This module computes the sum of the input field over a year.

exe:FUNCTION__XARRAY_ARIDITY_INDEX.sdo:description: This module computes the aridity index.

exe:FUNCTION__XCLIM_EVAPOTRANSPIRATION.sdo:description: The potential for water evaporation from soil and transpiration by plants if the water supply is sufficient, calculated with a given method.

exe:FUNCTION__XCLIM_RATE2AMOUNT.sdo:description: Convert a rate variable to an amount by multiplying by the sampling period length.
